definition.sourcePopulation: All original G02 target lexical word objects, preserving row/token order and IDs.
definition.geometry: Owning load_geometry and point_rotate helpers; no OCR, image operation, fitting or repair.
definition.numericDomain: Freeze owning finite float centers/guards/mask coordinates as exact binary rationals. Evaluate the closed square without clipping, rounding or added tolerance.
definition.sourcePredicate: a <= 2544-x < c and b <= y < d in original source rectangles.
definition.targetPredicate: a <= x < c and b <= y < d in original target rectangles.
definition.coupling: Source and target colors are evaluated at the same displaced point.
definition.partition: All rectangle edge coordinates, reflected source x edges, square endpoints, and one midpoint of every open interval; all Cartesian endpoint/interior cells.
definition.overlap: Any cell with both colors on either side makes the whole word unresolved. No color or zero state is guessed.
definition.compatibility: Compare nominal exact-rational colors with original float predicates; compare every original guard-unambiguous class with the full new class set. Any disagreement leaves the word unresolved.
definition.membership: must if every classifiable cell selects the word; optional if some do; out if none do; unresolved if any overlap or compatibility disagreement occurs.
definition.pathCounts: 2^optional per selector is only an independent-word assignment upper bound; null for any unresolved word. No strings or paths are generated.
